description: This file defines the EagerOperation class in the org.tensorflow package, representing an eager execution operation in TensorFlow. It includes methods to access operation details such as name, type, outputs, and tensors, as well as native handle management.

classes.name: EagerOperation
classes.description: Represents a TensorFlow operation executed eagerly, managing native handles and tensors, providing access to operation properties and tensor resolution.

classes.name: NativeReference
classes.description: Inner class managing native handle references and cleanup for an EagerOperation.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the operation.

methods.name: numOutputs
methods.description: Returns the number of outputs of this operation.

methods.name: outputListLength
methods.description: Returns the length of an output list specified by name.

methods.name: inputListLength
methods.description: Returns the length of an input list specified by name.

methods.name: getUnsafeNativeHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the native handle for a specific output index.

methods.name: shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the tensor at the specified output index.

methods.name: dtype
methods.description: Returns the data type of the tensor at the specified output index.

methods.name: tensor
methods.description: Returns the tensor at the specified output index, resolving it if necessary.
